DARV.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.0-0.char: So many gems! Can I take a few for bullets?
DARV.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.0-1.ancient: Sure! Take your pick. You look like you can handle yourself!
DARV.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.1-0r.ancien: Back again? Want to try this one? It is powerful!
DARV.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.2-0.ancient: That serious look... fine, take something good!
DARV.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.2-1.char: Thanks! I promise I will put it to good use!
DARV.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.2-2.ancient: Go on, then! Come back next time!
NEOW.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.0-0.char: I am back... What is the mission this time?
NEOW.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.0-1.ancient: [sine]...go... into... the tower... you... are ready...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.2-1.char: As long as I can keep fighting!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.0-: Your guns are loud. But your resolve... interesting.
Loud? Then you have not heard enough yet!
Then keep making noise. The tower is too quiet.
Then keep firing. I want to see how far you can go.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.1-: You return. This time, the tower will test you further.
A test? I am only worried about running out of ammo.
Then find more ammunition. The tower has plenty.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.2-: Still fighting? Then do not stop.
Then continue. This tower needs a sound like yours.
